newsitem.title: USA: Capitol existing banks to buoy earnings.
newsitem.headline: Capitol existing banks to buoy earnings.

text.p: Capitol Bancorp Ltd said Tuesday that its earnings for the rest of this year will rely on the strength of the company's six mature bank affiliates.

The company has a total of nine small community banks, with three of those less than one year old. Additional expansion plans are under way for new banks in the Michigan cities of Grand Rapids and Muskegon and Scottsdale, Ariz.

"Continued earning improvement for our three recently-added affiliates will be offset to some extent by the commencement of three more affiliates which we expect to be operative before the end of this calendar year," Chairman and Chief Executive Officer Joseph Reid said in a statement.
Capitol Bancorp reported first quarter net income of $1.3 million, or $0.27 a share, versus $1.1 million, or $0.26 a share.
